title: Tips Dataset
description: Your first end-to-end project: apply NumPy and Pandas basics to clean and explore a small restaurant tips dataset, then visualize the results.
businessProblem: Explore what factors are associated with higher tip amounts at a restaurant.
workflow: Load the dataset with pandas and inspect its structure
Practice NumPy operations on the numeric columns
Explore relationships between bill size, party size, and tip
Visualize findings with Matplotlib, then Seaborn
results: Tip amount scales closely with total bill size; party size and day of week show smaller but visible effects.
lessonsLearned: This project is designed to be revisited across Steps 2-6 of the Learning Guide, adding a new skill each pass.
